_comment: What the Chromium engine is built against. `cef_version` is the CEF binary distribution (cef-builds.spotifycdn.com) native/build.sh fetches and the app's engine.json must name; `cef_sha1` is the SHA-1 the CDN publishes beside each tarball, copied here so build.sh verifies what it fetched (and its cache) against a value the repository controls. x86_64 is null: Intel Macs ship no engine (owner, 2026-10-21). The engine ships inside the DMG (D1415, docs/CHROMIUM_ENGINE.md); there is no separate artifact or version.
